name: wal_init_zero
description: Controls whether new WAL files are pre-filled with zeroes before first use.
symptoms: Increased WAL initialization latency on COW filesystems
Wasted I/O bandwidth on filesystems that optimize sparse file allocation
Slower WAL file creation under high write load
tuning_tips: Disable wal_init_zero on Copy-On-Write (COW) filesystems like ZFS or Btrfs to avoid redundant zero writes; leave enabled on traditional filesystems (ext4, XFS) for predictable WAL file layout and reduced fragmentation.
